description: Borek presentation CI contract (Brand Guide 2.0). Visual grammar for Gamma theme and internal renderer; voice/editorial rules for Stage B content.
precedence_rule: Brand Guide explicit rules override Master Slides examples; White Paper patterns apply only where compatible with slide-density rules.

primary.name: Indigo
primary.role: primary brand color; cover/closing full bleed

rules: Indigo is the primary brand color.
Use at most one splash/highlight color per slide or visual context.
Splash colors must never carry text.
No gradients.
No shadows.
No decorative visual noise unless explicitly allowed.
Inter is the primary typeface.
Use Verdana or listed fallbacks only where the Brand Guide specifies.
Preserve title/body hierarchy.
Use at most two font weights per slide.
0 px corner radius on cards and containers.
Prefer thin rules and whitespace over decorative boxes.
Content slides use white background with date and page number footer.
Use approved Borek logo color variants only.
White logo on Indigo; Indigo logo on light backgrounds.
Never recolor the logo.
Do not place the Borek logo on normal content slides.
Write in active voice with short sentences.
State commitments with dates when source material supports them.
Do not use exclamation marks in customer-facing slide copy.
Do not use emoji.
Avoid the banned marketing vocabulary listed in this contract.
One clear idea per slide.
Titles should communicate the takeaway, not merely the topic.
SUCCESS_METRICS and KPI slides lead with the conclusion or takeaway in the title.
Prefer concrete numbers over adjectives.
Metrics must remain Framework-grounded.
Include clear next actions where applicable.
